title: Dementia 13
description:
S1
A mysterious masked killer terrorizes members of a family at a secluded estate.

title: The Forest
description:
S1
While investigating the disappearance of her twin sister, a young American encounters the tormented spirits of Japan's mysterious and legendary Aokigahara Forest.

title: Games
description:
S1
A mysterious woman (Simone Signoret) in black moves in with married Manhattan thrill-seekers (James Caan, Katharine Ross) and helps one trick the other.

title: Gone
description:
S1
A televangelist (Gregory Itzin) influences a confrontational man (Billy Burke) motivated by revenge.

title: The Green Inferno
description:
S1
Student activists (Lorenza Izzo, Ariel Levy) crash-land in the Amazon and encounter an indigenous tribe of cannibals who'd like to have them for dinner.

title: The Guardian
description:
S1
Yuppies (Dwier Brown, Carey Lowell) with a baby hire a nanny (Jenny Seagrove), a druid witch who sacrifices babies to a tree.

title: I Saw What You Did
description:
S1
Two teenage girls, bored while baby-sitting, make prank phone calls, completely unaware one of the people on the other end of the line has just killed his wife and now thinks the girls must be silenced.

title: Killer High
description:
S1
Sabrina's perfectly planned high school reunion goes south when a monster keeps killing all the guests.
